verdict.rationale: Brave documents a dedicated LLM Context endpoint built for machine consumption. It returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content for RAG, with configurable token and URL limits for sizing. Ranking is covered by Goggles re-ranking to control which sources ground the LLM, plus adjustable relevance threshold modes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the result quality and the 'most powerful Search API for AI' benchmark claim.
